enable_startup_timer: enable startup latency metrics by initializing the Prometheus gauge for tracking context durations
set_startup_metric: set a startup metric value for a named context with optional logging
test_startup_timer: test the startup_timer context manager to measure and record maximum latency for a code block
refactor_time_startup_latency: refactor the time_startup_latency decorator to measure function startup latency with optional logging
get_max_duration: get the maximum recorded duration for a given context name
